subtests.name: For same-origin createWorklet with custom dataOrigin https://web-platform.test:8443, where dataOrigin is same origin to the context's origin, test selectURL() and verify its data origin.
For same-origin createWorklet with custom dataOrigin https://www.web-platform.test:8443, where dataOrigin has opted in, test selectURL() and verify its data origin.
For same-origin createWorklet with custom dataOrigin https://www1.web-platform.test:8443, where dataOrigin has opted in with "*", test selectURL() and verify its data origin.
For same-origin createWorklet with custom dataOrigin https://www2.web-platform.test:8443, where dataOrigin has not opted in, worklet creation will fail.
For same-origin createWorklet with dataOrigin option "invalid", there is a TypeError thrown.
For same-origin createWorklet with opaque dataOrigin, there is an InvalidAccessError thrown.
